title: Solution Owner, EDA
description:
**Job Description**
The Solution Owner, EDA will play a crucial role in our FIT ITIS DO C&BA HW Engineering department. They will be accountable for the installation, maintenance, and compatibility testing of EDA tools. This role requires expertise in managing EDA environments, tool installation, and working with various industry-leading tools and software. The successful candidate will ensure the efficient and effective use of EDA tools, driving tool installation processes and running sanity test cases.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Accountable for EDA tool installation, maintenance, and compatibility testing and maintenance for RF, ASIC, Analog and FPGA design .
* Implement and maintain regression tools from Synopsys and Siemens.
* Conduct compatibility testing of open-source tools in a Linux environment.
* Drive and oversee the tool installation process for RF EDA tools.
* Run end-user sanity test cases for RF EDA tools from Ansys, Siemens, Dassault, and Keysight.
* Maintain service support documents and ensure proper documentation.
* Collaborate with Infra teams to resolve day-to-day issues and provide support.
* Debug EDA tool issues in a Linux GRID environment using Altair Accelerator, LSF, or SLURM.
* Stay updated with the latest advancements in EDA tools and technologies.
* Ensure smooth operations and efficient utilization of EDA resources.

**Key Skills And Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in supporting EDA environments globally.
* Proficiency in installing EDA tools in Linux environments, specifically RHEL8 or RHEL9.
* Familiarity with digital design flow for Digital IC design from Synopsys, Cadence, or Siemens.
* Working knowledge of digital EDA tools from Synopsys, Cadence, and Siemens.
* Experience with RF design tools from Ansys, Keysight, Dassault, and Modelithics.
* Understanding of FPGA design tools from AMD and Altera.
* Strong working knowledge of the Linux environment.
* Experience with EDA tools in GRID environments, such as LSF or Altair Accelerator.
* Scripting knowledge is a plus (e.g., shell scripting, Python, or Perl).

title: Senior Technical Specialist (R&D Lab)
description:
**Job Description**
 The R\&D Lab Specialist configures, designs, installs, maintains, and handles R\&D laboratory equipment and laboratory networks for the use of delivery teams. Procures, (budgets,) and integrates new products and solutions in the services laboratory. Ensures availability of laboratory equipment and maintains physical and environmental standards. Supports the integration, verification, testing, and modification of SW / HW / system components.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Responsible for all activities related to Lab Operation, IT Management, Cyber Security, Server infrastructure, and Sustainability.
* Align and standardize lab infra management world\-wide – Implementation of common tool and processes across all labs
* Cloud infra: E.g. allocate needed resources in order to support DevOps transformation \& Lab to Cloud strategy.
* Lab\-IT management: Maintaining a server, network planning, coordination with IT for new network requests/modifications, outages, firewall adaptations…
* Cybersecurity implementation, monitoring, Vulnerability Management Program in order to comply with Cyber security requirement.
* Quality adherence: ESD and calibration. TL9000, ISO45000, 14000, 27000 and BCP
* Daily Lab support to all DU’s based through Ticketing system via SLA and ad hoc interventions for problem solving
* Capex \& Opex – Budget Consolidation, Optimization
* Equipment Ordering, Shipment tracking, installation and registration.
* Lab Inventory Management, tracking utilization.
* Drive lab improvement program, innovation, tool enhancement.


**Key Skills And Experience**
 You have:
   

  

* B.E./B.Tech in relevant discipline
* 10\-12 years of experience in Networking \& Telecom domain
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (IP addressing, VLAN, routing \& switching)
* Experience in installation, configuration, and powering of network/telecom equipment
* Working knowledge of OS installation and security patch updates
* Hands\-on experience in ticket handling with understanding of SLA concepts
* Exposure to lab/network environment management including maintenance, backups, and restoration
* Good communication skills, positive attitude; CCNA or equivalent certification is an added advantage

title: Field Support Specialist II
description:
Dorman was founded on the belief that people should have greater freedom to fix motor vehicles. For over 100 years, we have been driving new solutions, releasing tens of thousands of aftermarket replacement products engineered to save time and money, and increase convenience and reliability. Founded and headquartered in the United States, we are a pioneering global organization offering an always\-evolving catalog of automotive, heavy\-duty and specialty vehicle products. Today, we have more than 3,800 employees across 29 different locations, with a family of brands that also includes SuperATV and Dayton Parts. Reaching a revenue of $2\.13 billion in 2025, Dorman is publicly traded under the stock ticker DORM.
   

  

 Everyone who works at Dorman is called a Contributor. We need everyone, regardless of role and experience, to contribute to our success. That means everyone has a unique ability to make an impact on the business. We encourage all our Contributors to bring their authentic selves to work. The freedom to pursue new ideas, offer different perspectives, and grow in your career is fundamental to working at Dorman.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Field Support Specialist II (FSS II) serves as the primary on\-site IT support resource for end users, delivering exceptional customer service and technical support across the organization's technology environment. This role is responsible for providing first and second\-level technical support, diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, networking, telephony, and collaboration technology issues, and escalating incidents when appropriate in accordance with established IT standards and procedures.
   

  

 The FSS II partners closely with employees, business leaders, and IT teams to ensure technology solutions are reliable, effective, and aligned with business needs. This position also supports technology deployments, conference room technologies, asset management, end\-user training, and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance the overall customer experience.
   

  

 Primary Duties
   

  

**End User Support \& Incident Management**
* Deliver professional, responsive, and customer\-focused technical support to end users across all supported technologies.
* Serve as the first point of contact for on\-site technology incidents, service requests, and troubleshooting activities.
* Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve hardware, software, operating system, mobile device, network, printing, and telephony issues.
* Utilize IT Service Management (ITSM) tools to receive, prioritize, document, track, and resolve incidents and service requests in accordance with defined service levels.
* Accurately document troubleshooting activities, root cause findings, resolutions, and customer communications.
* Escalate complex issues to appropriate support teams while maintaining ownership and communication throughout the resolution process.
* Coordinate and communicate effectively with Service Desk, Infrastructure, Applications, Security, and other IT support teams.


**Customer Experience \& Communication**
* Maintain a professional, positive, and service\-oriented attitude during all customer interactions and team engagements.
* Act as a trusted liaison between Information Technology and business stakeholders.
* Provide regular updates to customers and IT leadership regarding issue status, service interruptions, trends, and potential risks.
* Build strong working relationships with employees at all organizational levels.
* Promote a positive technology experience by delivering timely and effective support.


**Technology Deployment \& Asset Support**
* Configure, deploy, maintain, and support desktop and laptop computers, mobile devices, peripherals, and associated software.
* Support technology refresh initiatives, workstation deployments, software installations, and equipment moves, additions, and changes.
* Assist with inventory management, asset tracking, and lifecycle management of end\-user computing devices.
* Support local network connectivity, telephony equipment, printers, and collaboration technologies.


**Training \& Process Improvement**
* Provide end\-user training and guidance on supported applications, systems, and technologies.
* Create and maintain knowledge base articles, technical documentation, procedures, and support standards.
* Identify recurring issues and recommend improvements to processes, systems, and support practices.
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives designed to enhance service quality, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction.


**Conference Room \& Facilities Technology Support**
* Manage conference rooms and collaboration spaces to ensure operational readiness.
* Support audio, video, conferencing, and presentation technologies.
* Coordinate maintenance, repairs, and upgrades of conference room equipment as needed.
* Maintain inventories of supplies and accessories supporting collaboration technologies.


**Qualifications**
* Experience and hardware \& software support in a technical capacity.
* Customer service or related experience is a plus.
* Demonstrates complete competency of CS Level I skill set.
* Advance knowledge of hardware, software, networks and technical devices and terminology.
* Strong interpersonal skills.
* Good organizational skills with the ability to follow through.
* Excellent problem solving skills.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across hardware, software, networking, and collaboration technologies.
* Knowledge of Windows OS, Microsoft 365, Active Directory/Azure AD, VPN, printers, endpoint management, and basic network infrastructure.
* Excellent customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and work independently in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical, documentation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Understanding of IT security best practices, patch management, and compliance standards.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with global IT teams and business stakeholders.


 Education / Experience
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 2–5 years of experience in IT Support, End User Services, Service Desk, or Technical Support within a corporate environment.
* Experience supporting Windows operating systems, Microsoft 365, endpoint devices, networking, collaboration technologies, and enterprise IT infrastructure.
* Experience with IT Service Management (ITSM) tools, asset management, software deployment, and vendor coordination is preferred.
* Candidates willing to travel domestically across India to support business operations, IT deployments, and project activities are preferred.


**Working Conditions**
* Ability to travel between assigned facilities as required.
* Ability to lift and move computer equipment and peripherals within established safety guidelines.
* May require occasional after\-hours support, project participation, or on\-call responsibilities based on business needs.


 Dorman Products is an equal opportunity employer; we value a combination of ideas, perspectives, and cultures at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
